persona: Tomás, a retired teacher, chatty and precise, who talks about times the old-fashioned way.
goal: Book a filling one week from today ({{say:+7}}) at half past three in the afternoon. Say no to a reminder.

facts.phone number: +34 699 120 345 (say it as: plus three four, six nine nine, one two zero, three four five)
facts.day: a week from today, {{say:+7}} (say it as 'a week today')
facts.time: half past three in the afternoon (always say it that way)

moves: Open by saying you need to book a filling.
Say the day as 'a week today' and the time as 'half past three in the afternoon'; never say 3:30 or fifteen thirty.
